steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The NEA (Non-Exam Assessment) is a practical project that typically contributes 25-40% of the GCSE grade. | Key Fact: AQA Engineering NEA (40%): students produce engineering drawings, a working prototype and a portfolio. | Key Fact: WJEC Eduqas has two NEA units: Manufacturing Engineering Products (Unit 1) and Designing Engineering Products (Unit 2). | Key Fact: The portfolio must show clear progression through research, design, planning, manufacture and evaluation stages.

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from practical assessment technique, and one past-paper question.
